portable_rule: C++ TCK sources may include only the official RTI API headers and the C++ standard library. Shared ordinary-service scenario IDs are reused from the Java TCK catalog. Provider selection, link inputs, compile definitions, transport endpoints, and fault-injection fixtures belong to an adapter profile.
promotion_rule: A promoted scenario has passed the portable source-boundary check and both standard callback models in its adapter lane. Candidate scenarios remain opt-in until that evidence is recorded; availability status separately describes required adapter capabilities.
